major_cautions: 1791 and 1795 Fort Cochin are mainland India, not Sri Lanka; Cochin Raja's tribute pact and Dutch fort occupation distinct.
1795 August British fortress victories in coast; Kandyan king remained independent inland and had separate 1795/1796 treaties.
Colombo capitulation 15 Feb 1796 versus British+Sepoy occupation 16 Feb 1796.
Galle takeover on 23 Feb 1796 supported original Macquarie letter, not fabricated mass killing.

1797 village resistance followed multiple tax and administrative changes, including renter-magistrate authority and displaced grievance access; UK military violence not quantified without muster rolls.
Coconut tax abolished Sep 1797, no inferred complete withdrawal of other Company exactions.
No modern administrative province or route should be equated with historic occupied boundaries.
